pro_1.text: High above the clouds lies Aksharpur, where words keep the whole world alive.

pro_2.text: Every time someone reads, the great Story Tree grows a shining new leaf.

pro_3.text: But one little cloud had never, ever heard a story.

pro_4.text: Hee hee! Sounds, letters, words... now they're all mine!

pro_5.text: Oh no, oh no! The colours are gone, and the Story Tree is fading!

pro_6.text: You came! A real Explorer! Will you help me bring the words back?

pro_7.text: And so, the Quest for the Lost Words began.

sb_1.text: Look! The Star Bridge has appeared over the islands!

sb_2.text: Hee... you played through all seven islands? Then I have some riddles for you!

sb_3.text: Ready, Explorer? Let's show Gumsum everything you've learned!

so_1.text: A new season begins in Aksharpur.

so_2.text: You're really getting good at this. Maybe... reading isn't only for others?

so_3.text: Look, the islands are growing! New adventures are waiting for us!

g_warm.text: Let's try a warm-up one together.

g_chapter.text: Chapter complete! The island is growing!

beat_forest_0.text: Tinku's tabla has gone silent! Can you wake it up with the right sounds?

beat_forest_1.text: Koyal has lost her song. Listen closely and help her find it!

beat_forest_2.text: Gajju's drum is fast asleep. Every right sound gives it a beat!

beat_forest_3.text: Welcome to the Echo Cave. Every sound bounces back... listen carefully!

beat_forest_4.text: The fireflies dance to the rhythm. Let's give them one!

beat_forest_5.text: To cross the Rhyme River, step only on the stones that rhyme!

beat_forest_6.text: The Beat Bridge only holds when the sounds are right. Let's build it!

beat_forest_7.text: The bamboo is whispering sounds. Can you hear the words inside?

beat_forest_8.text: It's the midnight rehearsal! The band needs your sharpest ears.

beat_forest_9.text: Tonight is the Grand Jungle Concert! Lead the whole band, Maestro Explorer!

beat_valley_0.text: The first lantern of the festival is dark. Hit it with the right sound!

beat_valley_1.text: Garud's wind is blowing the lanterns around. Aim carefully!

beat_valley_2.text: These twin letters look alike. Listen, then choose!

beat_valley_3.text: The river lanterns are floating away. Light them before they go!

beat_valley_4.text: The festival gate opens only for the right letters.

beat_valley_5.text: Bolt crossed all the wires! Sounds and letters are mixed up.

beat_valley_6.text: The mountain echoes every sound. Which letters make it?

beat_valley_7.text: Time for the sky lantern parade! Let's light the whole sky!

beat_valley_8.text: Somewhere up there is the golden lantern. Find it with your best aim!

beat_valley_9.text: The Festival of Lights begins! Light every lantern in the valley!

beat_ocean_0.text: Bubbles and barnacles! The Bubble Rocket needs word fuel!

beat_ocean_1.text: Let's dive into the sunlight reef. Blend the sounds to steer!

beat_ocean_2.text: Coral's bridge is broken. Read the pieces to fix it!

beat_ocean_3.text: Strange signals from the twilight zone! Can you read them?

beat_ocean_4.text: A giant clam is guarding a pearl. Read the word to open it!

beat_ocean_5.text: The jellyfish light up when you read their names!

beat_ocean_6.text: Ping! The sonar shows words in the deep. Read them fast!

beat_ocean_7.text: We found a sunken ship! Its words are covered in sand.

beat_ocean_8.text: Down in the alien trench, creatures have the strangest names!

beat_ocean_9.text: The Pearl of Sounds is right below us! One last dive, Explorer!

beat_village_0.text: A mystery! Someone mixed up every word on the menu!

beat_village_1.text: Who switched the school sign? Find the right words to catch them!

beat_village_2.text: The bakery has a strange new sign. Let's investigate!

beat_village_3.text: Jugnu's night bazaar is dark. The right words will light it!

beat_village_4.text: The mangoes are missing! Follow the word clues!

beat_village_5.text: The post office letters are all jumbled. Sort them out, detective!

beat_village_6.text: The library has a riddle hidden in its words.

beat_village_7.text: Someone scribbled on the market map. Which words are real?

beat_village_8.text: The signboards are talking nonsense! Let's fix them!

beat_village_9.text: This is the biggest mystery in Word Village. Are you ready, detective?

beat_treasure_0.text: Our honeycomb is empty! Spell the words to fill it with honey.

beat_treasure_1.text: The baby bees are waiting to hatch. Every word helps one!

beat_treasure_2.text: Captain Kalam found his first rune! Spell it to open the chest.

beat_treasure_3.text: The pirate map is missing its words. Let's write them back!

beat_treasure_4.text: The queen needs honey words. Build them letter by letter!

beat_treasure_5.text: This chest is locked with a spelling lock!

beat_treasure_6.text: The waves keep washing away the words on Spelling Beach!

beat_treasure_7.text: Captain Kalam wrote a poem, but the parrot ate some letters!

beat_treasure_8.text: The treasure cave is full of word puzzles. Let's explore!

beat_treasure_9.text: The Golden Hive! Fill every cell, and the whole island will glow!

beat_castle_0.text: Kitabu forgot how his story begins! Can you read it with him?

beat_castle_1.text: The middle of this story has gone missing. Let's find it!

beat_castle_2.text: This ending ran away! Read carefully to bring it back.

beat_castle_3.text: We found a dragon's diary! What happened inside?

beat_castle_4.text: I have a riddle hidden in a story. Can you solve it?

beat_castle_5.text: The tower library is full of sleeping stories. Let's wake them!

beat_castle_6.text: The portraits are telling stories. Listen to what they say!

beat_castle_7.text: The secret staircase opens only for careful readers.

beat_castle_8.text: It's the midnight story hour. Every book is whispering!

beat_castle_9.text: The Great Story Restore! Bring back every ending in the castle!

beat_observatory_0.text: Let's map the stars of sounds!

beat_observatory_2.text: Can you connect the word stars?

beat_observatory_5.text: The Star Bridge gate is just ahead. One more star map!

how_soundOrchestra.text: Listen to the band, then pick the matching sound!

how_letterArcher.text: Hear the sound, then hit the matching letter!

how_wordRocket.text: Blend the sounds to power up the rocket!

how_wordDetective.text: Listen to the word, then find it among the look-alikes!

how_spellingHive.text: Hear the word, then build it with the honey tiles!

how_storyQuest.text: Read the little story, then answer the question!

how_starObservatory.text: Every star needs a different skill. Let's use them all!

det_intro_0.text: A mystery! Who took the mangoes from the market?

det_reveal_0.text: It was the goat! He just wanted a juicy snack. Case closed!

det_intro_1.text: A mystery! Who ate all the laddoos?

det_reveal_1.text: It was the little mouse! His tummy was rumbling. Case closed!

det_intro_2.text: A mystery! Who rang the temple bell at midnight?

det_reveal_2.text: It was the monkey! He wanted to make music. Case closed!

det_intro_3.text: A mystery! Who hid Arya's kite?

det_reveal_3.text: It was the parrot! He wanted to fly with it. Case closed!

det_intro_4.text: A mystery! Who splashed mud on the school wall?

det_reveal_4.text: It was the piglet! He was playing in the puddles. Case closed!

det_intro_5.text: A mystery! Who borrowed the library book?

det_reveal_5.text: It was the puppy! He wanted a bedtime story. Case closed!

det_accuse.text: Three clues! Now, detective, who did it?

det_think.text: Hmm… look at the clues again.

rocket_sputter.text: Oh no, the engine sputtered! Let's read the fuel cells again.

rocket_zone_1.text: Welcome to the Sunlight Zone, explorer. Read the fuel cells and we dive!

rocket_zone_2.text: Ahoy! The Twilight Zone. The water is getting darker.

rocket_zone_3.text: The Deep Zone! Only clever readers come this far.

rocket_zone_4.text: The Alien Trench! Strange creatures live here. Can you read their names?

rocket_pearl.text: There it is! The Pearl of Sounds! You found it, explorer!

rocket_blend.text: Swipe up to blend the sounds together!

tease_forest.text: Next time, my band learns a brand new song. Will you conduct?

tease_valley.text: Next time, the festival lanterns float even higher. Bring your best arrows!

tease_ocean.text: Next time, we dive deeper. Strange glowing creatures are waiting!

tease_village.text: Next time, Inspector Ullu has a NEW case. Someone switched more signs!

tease_treasure.text: Next time, more baby bees are ready to hatch in the hive.

tease_castle.text: Next time, Kitabu remembers another story. Let's find its ending!

tease_observatory.text: Next time, the stars draw a new map in the sky. Ready, explorer?

gift_found.text: Look what I found! You tried so hard, this is for you.

gem_found.text: A Story Gem! The whole island is shining because of you.

how_soundNinja.text: A true ninja hears every piece of a word! Slice the right sound fruit.

how_soundPortal.text: Beep! Drag a beam from the sound to its letter portal. Fix my portals!

how_wordBuilder.text: Build the name in the reef, block by block, and a new creature hatches!

how_wordFlash.text: Watch my fireflies! The word shines for a blink, then find it in the jars.

how_magicWriter.text: Arr! Trace the glowing rune with your finger and the chest will open!

portal_fixed.text: Beep boop! Portal fixed! A critter zooms through!

reef_hatch.text: Look! A brand new creature, named by you!

flash_catch.text: You caught it! Another stall lights up!

writer_open.text: Arr, the quill obeys you! The chest is open!

writer_again.text: Steady, matey. Follow the glowing line once more.

v3_pro_1.text: Long, long ago, high above the clouds, there was a realm called Aksharpur.

v3_pro_2.text: Animals, flowers and even little clouds lived there happily, because every evening they listened to stories.

v3_pro_3.text: The stories came from me, the Great Story Tree. But only seven Story Keepers could hear my voice and carry the stories to everyone.

v3_pro_4.text: Stories, stories, STORIES! Every night, laughing and listening! I am sick of stories!

v3_pro_5.text: One stormy night, Gumsum the storm cloud swept six Story Keepers away, to six storm islands.

v3_pro_6.text: They're gone! And my tail is hurt. I can't fly to the islands alone.

v3_pro_7.text: Without its Keepers, the Tree went silent, and Aksharpur turned grey.

v3_pro_8.text: With the very last of my light, I called for help. And you came, Explorer.

v3_pro_9.text: You came! Will you help me rescue the Story Keepers? Together, we can do it!

v3_pro_10.text: Each Keeper is locked in a cloud cage. Win every key on an island, and the cage will open!

v3_start_forest_1.text: No music! No stories! I'm Drizzle, and this forest stays quiet!

v3_start_forest_2.text: Explorer! Over here! Win every key and this cage will open. My band needs me!

v3_start_forest_3.text: Two games on this island, four levels each. Get every answer right to win all the keys!

v3_rescue_forest_1.text: No, no, no! My quiet! It's popping!

v3_rescue_forest_2.text: I'm free! Thank you, Explorer! Band, play from the top!

v3_rescue_forest_3.text: Sound Forest is full of stories again! One more light for the Story Tree!

v3_start_valley_1.text: I'm Gust! I tangled every kite string. No letters fly on MY watch!

v3_start_valley_2.text: Explorer! I'm stuck in this cloud! Win every key and set me free, so the lanterns can fly again!

v3_start_valley_3.text: Two games on this island, four levels each. Get every answer right to win all the keys!

v3_rescue_valley_2.text: I'm free! Thank you! Look, every lantern is flying again!

v3_rescue_valley_3.text: Symbol Valley is full of stories again! One more light for the Story Tree!

v3_start_ocean_1.text: Murk is the name. The lagoon stays grey and the rocket stays stuck!

v3_start_ocean_2.text: Bubbles and barnacles! Explorer, win every key on this island and open my cage!

v3_start_ocean_3.text: Two games on this island, four levels each. Get every answer right to win all the keys!

v3_rescue_ocean_2.text: Free as a fish! Thank you, Explorer! Full speed ahead!

v3_rescue_ocean_3.text: Word Ocean is full of stories again! One more light for the Story Tree!

v3_start_village_1.text: Smudge here! I smudged every sign in this village. Nobody can read a thing!

v3_start_village_2.text: A rescue! Excellent. Explorer, every key opens one more lock. Find them all!

v3_start_village_3.text: Two games on this island, four levels each. Get every answer right to win all the keys!

v3_rescue_village_2.text: Case closed! You freed me, Explorer. Splendid detective work!

v3_rescue_village_3.text: Word Village is full of stories again! One more light for the Story Tree!

v3_start_treasure_1.text: I'm Sulk. The honey jar is locked and the bees can't spell a single word!

v3_start_treasure_2.text: Hmm, little one, every key you win brings me closer to my hive. Win them all!

v3_start_treasure_3.text: Two games on this island, four levels each. Get every answer right to win all the keys!

v3_rescue_treasure_2.text: I'm free! Thank you, little one. Hear the hive hum again!

v3_rescue_treasure_3.text: Treasure Island is full of stories again! One more light for the Story Tree!

v3_start_castle_1.text: Shhh! I'm Hush. Every book in this castle is closed forever!

v3_start_castle_2.text: Explorer! Kitabu and I are stuck. Win every key, and the books will open again!

v3_start_castle_3.text: Two games on this island, four levels each. Get every answer right to win all the keys!

v3_rescue_castle_2.text: We're free! Thank you, Explorer! Kitabu, open your pages!

v3_rescue_castle_3.text: Story Castle is full of stories again! One more light for the Story Tree!

v3_trial_1.text: Six Story Keepers are free! But Gumsum still holds the seventh island, the Storm Citadel.

v3_trial_2.text: So, you freed my prisoners? Then face my STORM TRIAL!

v3_trial_3.text: Thirty questions. Answer twenty-one right, and my storm breaks. Fail, and it stays!

v3_trial_4.text: We can do this together, Explorer! Everything you learned will help you now.

v3_retry_1.text: Ha! My storm holds... for now!

v3_retry_2.text: So close! Let us practise with our friends and try again.

v3_fin_1.text: Every story you read became light, and the light shone through all seven Keepers.

v3_fin_2.text: Nobody... ever told me a story. Everyone else had stories. I only had thunder.

v3_fin_3.text: Then here is your very first story, Gumsum.

v3_fin_4.text: May I stay, and water the Story Tree, and listen every evening?

v3_fin_5.text: Of course. Everyone deserves a story.

v3_fin_6.text: You did it, Explorer! Aksharpur is full of stories again!

v3_key_1.text: Keys! Every key brings us closer to the cage.

v3_pro_2b.text: Seven friends carried my stories: Milo the fox, Maestro Bhalu, Arya, Captain Kachhua, Inspector Ullu, Queen Madhu and Princess Pari.

v3_fin_7.text: And so the storm became rain, the rain became flowers, and Aksharpur sang until morning. The end... or perhaps, a new beginning.

v3_gen_r2.text: Click, click, click! The last key turns, and the cloud cage bursts into soft, fluffy puffs!

v3_gen_r5.text: A new light glows in my branches. I can feel the stories coming home.

v3_sf_s1.text: High in the clouds floats Sound Forest, where every tree hums and every leaf has a song.

v3_sf_s2.text: But listen... it is so quiet. Where is the music?

v3_sf_s5.text: The little band has gone silent. Tinku, Koyal and Gajju are waiting for their Maestro.

v3_sf_s7.text: Win the keys, wake the band, and the whole forest will sing again.

v3_sf_r2.text: The cage bursts open, and out hops Maestro Bhalu, ready to conduct!

v3_sf_r5.text: One, two, three, and a-ONE! Tinku, Koyal, Gajju, wake up, my friends!

v3_sf_r7.text: Hear that? The whole forest is singing, and the first light of the Story Tree is glowing.

v3_wv_s1.text: Word Village is where every word has a home: on signs, on shop fronts, on little wooden doors.

v3_wv_s2.text: But look! Every sign is a blotchy smudge. Nobody can read a thing.

v3_wv_s5.text: Even the letters are lost, wandering around like puzzled little ducklings.

v3_wv_s7.text: Find the clues, solve the cases, and every word will shine again! Hoo-hoo!

v3_wv_r2.text: Click! The last key turns, and Inspector Ullu's cage melts away like morning mist.

v3_wv_r4.text: One by one the signs shine clear: BAKERY, LIBRARY, SCHOOL. Every word is home again.

v3_wv_r5.text: Case closed! Splendid work, young detective. Hoo-hoo!

v3_gen_s1_valley.text: Symbol Valley is the home of every letter, from sleepy A to zippy Z.

v3_gen_s5_valley.text: Together we will make every letter shine again!

v3_gen_s1_ocean.text: Word Ocean is where little sounds swim together and blend into words.

v3_gen_s5_ocean.text: Ahoy, Explorer! Full sail to the next key!

v3_gen_s1_treasure.text: On Treasure Island every word is a treasure, and every treasure is spelled just so.

v3_gen_s5_treasure.text: Bzzz! Sweet success is only a few keys away!

v3_gen_s1_castle.text: Story Castle is where stories live, with a tower for every tale.

v3_gen_s5_castle.text: Every story is waiting. Let us open them all!
